root_cause.manifest_runtime_mismatch: The generated manifest declared the physical Futaleufu Landscape DefaultLit, while LoadOrCreateLandscapeCandidateMaterial assigned MSM_Unlit to Futaleufu and Chilko. The resulting near-bank terrain ignored the scene-lighting contract and read as a nearly black low-information strip.
root_cause.repetition_problem: The prior material combined registered macro and shared detail textures but had no river-local world-space palette variation, leaving smooth broad banks and source-scale repetition visible.
root_cause.retained_fix: Futaleufu now joins the existing Default Lit landscape allow-list and applies a river-local shade-only organic temperate graph after source, wet-bank, riverbed, and slope conditioning.

terrain_authority.terrain: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 surface model, corridor-conditioned, EGM2008 orthometric heights
